title: Outline Role Assignment
description: Single-primary-role assignments for every outline item, together with any newly invented functional roles.

invented_roles.description: Roles invented because no base-vocabulary role correctly captured an item's primary function. May be empty.

items.description: Exactly one primary-role assignment for every supplied outline item, in the original item order.

name.description: A unique one-to-three-word functional role name that does not duplicate a base-role name.

definition.description: One sentence defining the content or bounded component labelled by the invented role.

assignment_test.description: One sentence stating when the invented role should be selected as an item's single primary role.

distinguished_from.description: One sentence identifying the nearest base or invented competitor and the decisive functional distinction.

id.description: The ID of the corresponding outline item.

role_name.description: The exact name of either a supplied base role or a role defined in invented_roles.

is_invented.description: True exactly when role_name refers to a role defined in invented_roles.
